title: NOAA NHC Active Tropical Cyclones
description: Active tropical storms and hurricanes globally from the National Hurricane Center. Each storm is classified by basin (North Atlantic, East Pacific, West Pacific, Indian Ocean) with an investable thesis: Atlantic → Gulf refinery & reinsurance (USO, XLE, TRV, RE, FL/NC insurers); East Pacific → Mexico tourism/manufacturing (EWW); West Pacific → Japan/Taiwan/Philippines supply chain (TSM, Sony, EWT, EPHE); Indian Ocean → India/Bangladesh emerging markets (INDA). Severity tier derived from classification + intensity (major hurricane ≥ Cat 3 at 111+ kts flagged MAJOR). Feeds the Global Macro Risk Brief alert group. Free NHC JSON feed, no auth required.
